'''Reg''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3631 BBY]] he was approached in the [[Old World]] by a renegade member of the [[Knights of Zakuul]] [[Senya Tirall]], who was looking for information about the [[SCORPIO|Lady of Sorrows]]. Afraid that the presence of a Knight in the Old World would be put on him by the [[Heralds of Zildrog]], he alerted the Heralds to Tirall's presence. With the help of [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] Senya killed the Heralds and proceeded to interrogate Reg. Unable to connect her to the Lady of Sorrows, Reg send her to [[Mona Gale]] instead. However, shortly after Senya and the Outlander left, Reg was killed by the Heralds of [[Zildrog]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Reg appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' "Chapter 7: The Lady of Sorrows".
